description: Draft a pitch email to the author of a cited page and save it as the page's Outreach draft, replacing any previous draft. Uses the website's team-wide Outreach custom instructions, the saved author name, and the sender's name. Costs 0.1 credits per draft written (billed in whole credits every 10 drafts); free when the page cannot be read. Show the draft to the user before they send it; nothing is sent.

sender_name.description: Name to sign the email with. Defaults to the signed-in user's profile name; required for API-key sessions that should sign with a name.

url.description: Cited page URL, e.g. "example.com/blog/best-tools". A contact already saved under this exact URL (for example one the Outreach page saved for a query variant its URL rules list separately) is used first. Otherwise protocol, "www." and the query string (tracking parameters) are ignored, as on the Outreach page. The page is always read at the URL given.

name: draft_outreach_message

email_source.description: Where the email came from: page_author (published on the page and matches the author), page_contact (the site's own address, may not reach the author), hunter (Hunter.io match, not published on the page, check before sending), manual (entered by a person). Null when unknown.

page_emails.description: Up to five addresses the page or its linked contact page publishes, the chosen one first. Not a complete inventory.

created.description: True when this call created the page's contact.
